notices.short_title: LOCAL LAW 43 OF 2026 OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK IN RELATION TO THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE CONEY ISLAND BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT
notices.plain: The City Clerk published notice of Local Law 43 of 2026, which establishes the Coney Island Business Improvement District.

notices.short_title: New York Department of Finance  FY-2027 Regulatory Agenda
notices.plain: The Department of Finance published its regulatory agenda for fiscal year 2027, listing the rules it plans to propose or adopt during that period.

notices.short_title: Navillus - Solar PV Systems Design Build (Stipend)
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Navillus Tile Inc a $35,000 stipend for solar PV systems design-build work, selected through an innovative procurement method.
The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for construction work on the 25th floor at 1 Centre Street, with responses due June 25, 2026, and the lowest qualified bid will win.

notices.short_title: Construction and Installation for Stertil Koni Lift
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded Stertil Koni USA Inc a $296,000 contract for construction and installation of a Stertil Koni lift, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.vendor_name: Dice It Solutions Limited Liability Company
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Dice It Solutions Limited Liability Company a $1.11 million contract for IT consulting on enterprise document automation, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: FY27 NAEs for Multiple DVS Emergency Shelters
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration intends to award contracts for emergency shelter services at multiple domestic violence shelters for fiscal year 2027, using a negotiated acquisition with selected vendors, with responses due April 29, 2026.
The Employees' Retirement System awarded Rangam Consultants Inc a $489,528 contract for Salesforce consulting services through a small purchase.
The Employees' Retirement System awarded VPMA Global Services LLC a $1.4 million contract for a Control M platform, selected through a government-to-government purchase.

notices.short_title: EA -ODHR Society for Human Resource Management Training & Conference 6084031X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded the Society for Human Resource Management a $99,400 services contract for human resource training and a conference, with the selection method listed only as "Other.

notices.short_title: NAE with Comunilife for 146th Street Safe Haven
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to award a contract to Comunilife for the 146th Street Safe Haven through a negotiated acquisition, with responses due May 7, 2026.

The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications awarded Millennium Info Tech Inc. a $309,505 contract for NG911 specialist services for the city's emergency call system, chosen through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded New York Foundling a $1,658,618 contract for fiscal year 2027 alternative-to-incarceration programs.

notices.vendor_name: Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services Inc.
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services Inc. a $10.65 million contract for fiscal year 2027 alternative-to-incarceration programs.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded Osborne Treatment Services Inc a $2.3 million contract for alternative-to-incarceration programs in fiscal year 2027.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded Housing Works Inc. a $1.5 million contract for fiscal year 2027 alternative-to-incarceration programs.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded Rising Ground Inc. a $1.39 million contract for alternative-to-incarceration programs in fiscal year 2027.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded Urban Youth Alliance International Inc a $1,475,673 contract for Fiscal Year 2027 Alternative-to-Incarceration programs.
The Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice awarded a $3 million human services contract to 67th Precinct Clergy Council Inc for the FY27 Partners Against the Hate (PATH) program.

notices.short_title: CGRTB-Rental of CUNY Facilities for GreenThumb's Conference
notices.vendor_name: CUNY Graduate School Auxiliary Enterprise Corporation
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded a $84,110 contract to the CUNY Graduate School Auxiliary Enterprise Corporation to rent CUNY facilities for GreenThumb's conference, through a government-to-government purchase.

notices.short_title: B085-124M Metropolitan Recreation Center Dehumidification System Recon.
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Sienia Construction Inc a $943,750 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to reconstruct the dehumidification system at the Metropolitan Recreation Center.
The Police Department awarded Finesse Creations Inc a $1.349 million emergency purchase contract for metal barricades.

notices.vendor_name: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation awarded New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc a $75,000 contract for its DSNY Digitization Project, using a required method that directs the city to buy from this preferred source.
The School Construction Authority is seeking bids, due May 12, 2026, for construction work on parapets, roofs and exterior masonry, with the lowest qualified bid to win.
The Department of Transportation awarded Faztec Industries Inc a contract worth $1.8 million for disposal services, chosen through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development posted a public comment notice on contract awards for housing and tenant support services.

The Department of Youth and Community Development published a notice on April 28, 2026, about a Negotiated Acquisition for the Summer Youth Employment Program, with the vendor, amount and time period not given in the title.
The Mayor's Office of Contract Services published a notice on April 28, 2026, under the title "LL63/DOT/EXT," which gives too little detail to say more about its subject.
